bugs.title: Timed-out exit that later fills is booked under the cancelled stop id and labelled SL
bugs.impact: P&L is right, but the ledger names the wrong order and calls a trailing-stop exit a stop-loss, so reviews and EOD ledger checks fail daily.
evidence: trades.db rows 3391-3392 (JSWENERGY) and 3403-3404 (ADANIENT): TIMEOUT exit with empty order_id, then SUCCESS close under SL order ids 26103035121544 and 26103035119260 labelled 'Closed by tracker (SL)'
eod ledger check FAIL: 2 broker fills with no matching engine order (ADANIENT, JSWENERGY); logs say exit orders 26103036923667 and 26103038430811 completed at the broker
bugs.root_cause: The FILLED branch of sweep_unresolved_orders (main.py) never gave the filled exit id to the tracked position; book_close() then wrote pos.sl_order_id (the cancelled stop), and _poll_close_exit_types() defaulted the label to SL.
bugs.fix: Sweep sets pos.sl_order_id to the filled exit; a full exit records its label in TrackedPosition.claimed_exit before sending, and the poll books the close under it (adae1b78a).

history.note: fixed 2026-10-31, uncommitted; needs one clean session with a timed-out exit to verify

bugs.title: Order and history calls time out 25-30 s after 5-minute candle closes
bugs.impact: Order timeouts drive every bookkeeping bug above; a 20-minute positionbook outage on 10-28 left the engine blind.
evidence: execution-health: Timeout sending order x12, slow sandbox place_order above 5 s x10, limiter critical-lane max wait 13.4 s, refused calls 1447
bugs.root_cause: Not the rate limiter (critical-lane wait 0 at 10:15 on 10-30). The sandbox executes fills one at a time under ExecutionEngine._position_lock (class-wide, also guards the shared funds row): six orders at 10:15:23 took 3.7/3.8/5.3/8.7/10.4/12.7 s (execute stage), so every order past the 5 s client timeout became uncertain.
bugs.fix: signal_engine: placeorder uses api.order_timeout 20 s (other calls stay 5 s), covering the measured burst; genuine timeouts still reconcile and watch for late fills. Test: test_order_timeout.py. The sandbox lock itself is not changed: b6887f319 logs the time inside the lock per fill, needed before narrowing it.

bugs.title: eod.sh re-run for a past day reviews the BreakingTrade scanner for the run date, not the requested day
bugs.impact: A re-run of an earlier day's EOD report shows 0 BreakingTrade signals/trades (it reviews today), so the re-run report silently loses that section; reporting only, no trading effect.
evidence: reports/eod-2026-10-30.md (re-run 2026-10-31 16:58) shows 'INTRADAY PAPER REVIEW - 2026-10-31 (Saturday)', 0 signals; reports/original-2026-10-30/eod-2026-10-30.md (15:25) shows 7 signals, 11 trades
eod.sh:112 calls 'breakingtrade --review' with no day; __main__.py:904 calls review.report() with no argument; review.py:106-107 defaults day to ist_today()
Same re-run also showed Positions page 0.0 and Broker +0.00 vs 528.5 in the original (appears to read live sandbox state; not traced in code)
bugs.root_cause: The --review CLI path has no day argument, so review.report() falls back to ist_today(). Fix: add --day to the breakingtrade CLI, pass it to review.report(day), call it with --day "$DAY" from eod.sh; add a test that a past-day review reads that day.

bugs.title: Two value-area implementations give different VAH/POC/VAL
bugs.impact: Backtests of value_area_fade and open_drive use backtest/volume_profile.py (close-only bins, MarketProfile library); the breakout runner and the stored dataset use features/value_area.py (volume spread over each bar's range). A result from one does not transfer to the other.
bugs.root_cause: backtest/volume_profile.py used the MarketProfile library (close-only bins, ~30 rows per session); features/value_area.py spreads volume over each bar's range in rows of 5 ticks.
bugs.fix: One calculation: volume_profile.session_value_area now calls features/value_area (range-spread, one row at a time toward the heavier neighbour, 70%, continuous session before 15:15), rows of 5 NSE ticks in force on each session's date (tick_reference). Store rebuilt as range-spread-nse-tick-v2 (456,256 rows, 214 symbols, 2016-10-03..2026-10-30; v1 removed; POC moved in 12.8% of sessions, mean 1.4 bps). Tests: test_volume_profile.py, test_value_area_fade.py, test_open_drive.py, test_value_area_store.py.
bugs.verification: 2026-10-31: backtest and store share one function; 51 value-area tests pass; store coverage 2026-10-30 211/211.
